findings.summary: Branch 2 silently locks a blocking gate to a superseded template matcher — a /hooks-UI mixed group carrying the OLD matcher keeps it forever and the widened matcher is never registered
findings.suggestion: Do not treat a differing user matcher as unambiguous. Either emit the branch-3 warning before dropping, or ship the residual matcher (template alternation minus the user's) so coverage is preserved.

findings.summary: Branch 2 silently re-adopts the matcher-difference inference ADR-009 withdrew on the flat path
findings.suggestion: When branch 2 fires with tm not in user_matchers, emit a WARN naming the shadowed template matcher and the user matcher.

findings.summary: The ambiguity warning is keyed per-command, so a command suppressed on one entry and left on another stays silent despite a real double-fire
findings.suggestion: Warn per (cmd, user_matcher): after building emitted_template, warn when a command is still carried by an emitted template entry AND by a preserved user entry.

findings.summary: ADR-007's refresh assumes the template text is validated, but `_compute_install_ref` validates only the `file://` branch — the two `_HARNESS_MAKER_PKG_ROOT` returns are unchecked
findings.suggestion: Apply `_is_resolvable_project` to the PKG_ROOT returns too, or skip the refresh when the template's own text fails the same predicate.

findings.summary: The refresh replaces the whole command string, discarding any user-authored prefix before `python -m` (env assignments, PATH shims)
findings.suggestion: Refresh only when the preserved text matches the harness's own shape; otherwise leave it and warn.

findings.summary: A harness command the user gave extra arguments has a different normalized identity, so it is neither refreshed nor suppressed — its stale `--with` survives and double-fires beside the template's
findings.suggestion: When a preserved `<HM>:` command has no `shipped_text` counterpart, warn naming the entry and command; do not auto-refresh across differing args.

findings.summary: ADR-009's Cursor duplicate is silent, and `telemetry` on the flat `postToolUse *` entry appends a row per invocation — the duplicate doubles the ledger denominator
findings.suggestion: Emit the branch-3 warning on the flat path too when a user entry already carries a shipped command under another matcher.

findings.summary: `_pinned_distribution_ref`'s non-release warning bypasses `_INSTALL_REF_WARNED`, so it fires four times per make — the exact readability failure that set was added to prevent
findings.suggestion: Route it through the same dedup set keyed on the version string, and assert the count in the test.

findings.summary: `_INSTALLABLE_ARCHIVE_SUFFIXES` omits `.tar.bz2` and `.tar.xz`, which pip and uv both install
